config.failure_action: save completed rows and budgets, mark remaining UNDETERMINED, mandatory STOP; phase/contrast unresolved are per-row diagnostics

model_accounting.algorithm_enclosure: triangle-inequality magnitude interval using total discrepancy numerical ball enlarged by eta; no algorithm-only point value or exact separation
model_accounting.attribution: MODEL_TARGET_CONFOUNDED if eta>0; B=0 proves model equality; no result-dependent tolerance or grid change
model_accounting.contrast: shared minus comparator is direct same-H_tilde visibility contrast; no model budget added to its numerical radius
model_accounting.legacy_direct_full_HD_comparison: UNDETERMINED_NOT_SAVED; new reconstruction does not recover missing v5 matrices
model_accounting.method_target: H_tilde_j=HD_j+HR_saved_j; z_tilde_ideal is defined but not evaluated
model_accounting.model_phase: conditional principal-phase bound only if raw visibility lower L and L-eta exceed 1/4, eta<L, union disk excludes zero and negative-real branch cut; otherwise UNDETERMINED
model_accounting.operator_bound: B_j=max_row sum(abs(Re DeltaH_j)+abs(Im DeltaH_j)) >= norm_2(DeltaH_j), conditional on exact Hermiticity
model_accounting.raw_reference: H_full; z_full=<psi exp(+i T H_full) psi>/original_norm2
model_accounting.signal_bound: eta_j(T)=abs(T)*B_j; exact rational ledger, separate from numerical precision gate
model_accounting.total_discrepancy: computed z_method-z_full with numerical radius only; TOTAL_COMPLEX_DISCREPANCY_TO_RAW_H, never pure algorithm error

precision.comparison: difference intervals use sum of signal radii; visibility advantage resolved only if interval excludes zero; no scientific GO threshold
precision.independent_correctness: future one-shot only: exact rational 2x2 physical-word enumeration, degree32 Taylor with analytic remainder, R2/s2/noncommuting HD; direct twirl vs FWHT; full256 literal-tensor monomial twirl probes for every split
precision.phase: principal Arg(z conj(z_ref)); no unwrap; balls intersecting negative-real branch cut or floor => UNDETERMINED_PHASE
precision.phase_library_model: complex abs/hypot relative error <=2u; asin/atan2/log absolute allowance 2^-51 on accepted domain; conditional and unverified
precision.radius_model: conditional upper norms, propagated operand errors, nextafter outward scalar budgets; not a platform certificate
precision.relative_ratio: null unless denominator loss interval excludes zero; never promote G9 relative ratios below absolute precision
precision.scalar_budget_evaluation: positive expressions <64 operations: relative 512u headroom plus nextafter; no unaccounted underflow
precision.trig_model: sin/cos argument exact-to-float error plus absolute 2^-51 library allowance; unverified assumption
precision.underflow: no unaccounted underflow/FTZ/overflow; observed subnormals or nonfinite => technical STOP; zero-producing underflow remains an assumption

semantics.independent: r=R/2 on each branch; angle=lambda*delta/R; V=D M_angle^(R/2) D; z=<(V^s)(V^s)>; never V_dagger
semantics.negative_branch: same label order with every sign reversed; not full-word adjoint
semantics.ordinary: r=R; angle=lambda*delta/R; O=Do M_angle^R Do; Do=exp(+i delta HD/2); z=<O^s>
semantics.sampling: positions and steps IID; no trajectory Monte Carlo; exact expectation recursion
semantics.shared: r=R; theta=lambda*delta/(2R); Psi(X)=D Phi_theta^R(D X D) D; D=exp(+i delta HD/4)
